grouping_basis: Provisional named locality/reach grouping, not surveyed river segmentation or statistically independent units. Preserve all records; first average records sharing a PIM cell within each group, then average unique cells per group, then give each of four groups equal weight. No best-hit representative selection.
radius_method: 0 m: containing pixel. Positive radii: presence of a High cell centre within Euclidean radius. Not calibrated location error bounds. NoData excluded from background denominator, never counted low.
background_method: Uniform valid pixel centres, full PIM domain and union of 1000 m around reference locations. Local background is conditioned on reported sites, not unaffected controls. Nearest High search uses all valid PIM cells, including outside each background mask; no support beyond raster extent.
interpretation: Descriptive sensitivity only, not accuracy or statistical significance. Evidence types remain separate; evacuation and response do not prove inundation. Coordinate precision estimates in source catalog are unverified. Sources span multiple event/response days; nominal event_date is not a per-location observation date.
